name: Arrow code (deep nesting)
source: Arrow anti-pattern: conditions nested until the work sits at the point of the arrow; the fix is guard clauses and early returns (Fowler, Refactoring, 'Replace Nested Conditional with Guard Clauses')
seed: complexity.max_nesting_depth in pkg/codesignal/project_continuity.go and pkg/semantics/ts_scope.go (a baseline scan of main at 6d98ea0)
note: The expected rules are those of the smallest nest, one that trips only complexity.max_nesting_depth. A deeper, realistic arrow (six nested constructs) also trips complexity.cognitive_complexity (21 against a threshold of 15), so the single expected rule is not exhaustive of what Coach reports on arrow code.
